submission.natural_language_explanation: openai-community/gpt2 L1/H2 is a start-anchored positional head, not a content detector: its strength is set by absolute token position in the input, high at the first positions (~15.5-15.8 at positions 1-4 of ordinary text), lowest in the middle (~1.7-2.0 around positions 90-100) and rising again in a broad late lobe (~5 at position 127, ~9 at positions 170-200), so every text of two or more tokens is predicted active (its peak always lies in positions 1-5, far above the 4.2 active line) while inside a long text the unit is inactive at roughly positions 70-115. The opening tokens set only the height of that early peak: it reaches the maximum 16.79 at position 4 when the text opens with a run of space tokens (six spaces before the first word, 16.2-16.8 rising along the run), any non-space opening peaks at 15.3-16.1 around positions 2-4, and rewording everything after the opening leaves the peak unchanged.
